description: The live browser build at phone and desktop sizes, shot with darkroom's web backend (https://github.com/Preponderous-Software/darkroom): one shot per device, each opening the game once per screen through the URL options of docs/WEB.md and writing one still per screen. Needs Node.js and Playwright (cd src/BeyondNations.Web/smoke && npm ci && npx playwright install chromium; then NODE_PATH=src/BeyondNations.Web/smoke/node_modules). Run: darkroom shoot tools/capture/web.json. --var base=http://localhost:8080/ shoots a local publish instead. See docs/CONTRIBUTING.md.

defaults.comment: Headless Chromium draws WebGL with SwiftShader at about 4 to 9 frames a second at DPR 3, and every goto boots the .NET runtime again, so the waits are long. ready waits for the game's own status (window.beyondNations.status(), docs/WEB.md): 15 frames drawn and, in the world, something drawn.
defaults.ready: (() => { const s = window.beyondNations && window.beyondNations.status(); return !!(s && s.frames > 15 && (s.screen !== 'WORLD' || s.instancesDrawn > 0)); })()

shots.name: phone
shots.comment: 390x844 at DPR 3 with touch. The rotate hint shows once per page load and covers the middle of the screen; its OK button is tapped at (334, 338) before the screens behind it are shot. Trade at Market sits at (207, 367) in the market town's command bar.
shots.caption: The browser build on a phone held upright (390x844, touch).
